name: Mole Valley

licensing.additional: No additional HMO licensing scheme: only the national mandatory licence for HMOs with five or more people from two or more households sharing facilities. From 1 April 2027 the council is to be replaced by the new East Surrey Council.
licensing.fee: £868.50 for an HMO licence, with £50 off for members of a recognised landlords' association

councilTax.text: £2,519.86 average Band D (2026/27), including Surrey County Council, Surrey police and average parish precepts

housing: Mole Valley is a mostly owner-occupied part of Surrey, with the towns of Dorking and Leatherhead, the suburban villages of Ashtead, Fetcham and Bookham, and rural villages in the Surrey Hills. Private lets are mainly flats in the town centres, Victorian terraces in Dorking and family houses in the suburbs. Many rural homes are older cottages, some listed and off mains gas, and Charlwood and Hookwood sit next to Gatwick.
checkinTips: Older cottages in the Surrey Hills villages: photograph beams, uneven floors, any wood burner and flue, and damp in solid walls.
Rural homes off mains gas: photograph the oil tank, its gauge level and the boiler service label.
Flats in Leatherhead and Dorking town centres: note the communal entrance, fire doors, bike and bin stores, and key and fob counts.
Homes near the River Mole: record any signs of past flooding on floors and lower walls.
Homes in Charlwood and Hookwood near Gatwick: note window seals and any secondary glazing, and test that windows open and lock.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair or safety concerns can contact Mole Valley District Council's housing team, which deals with repairs in rented homes and HMO licensing.
